structured_output.notes: Few in-window items could be confirmed. The Hindu pages and the Deccan Herald Hebbal pages returned errors. I could not find the original articles for the Bannerghatta Road junction DPR (13-14 Oct), the Mysuru Road 60-year-old bridge, the Hebbal Finance Department concerns (TNIE), the Assetz Twin Lake City piece, or the Swan Realty Bodhi launch (Jayanagar, outside focus). I did not report them because I had no quotable text. A search summary said the cabinet approved Rs 2,215 crore for the Hebbal tunnel and Mehkri Circle elevated corridor, but I never saw the text on a page, so it is not a claim. Century Astoria (10 Oct), the Hilton signing (6 Oct) and the Hebbal tree counts (10 Oct) were published before the window opened (12 Oct 05:41 IST) and are marked with their true dates. The Hilton page showed no year; 2026 is inferred from the search listing. The Sadahalli items and the High Court order are background. Searches for Electronic City, Hosur Road, Kanakapura Road, Kengeri, Tumkur Road and Magadi Road found nothing dated in the window. Assetz Twin Lake City (Horamavu, about 21 acres, 1,220 homes, 3 and 4 BHK) appeared only on aggregators with conflicting prices and RERA reported as pending, so I left it out.
